newsitem.title: FRANCE: Industry sees French maize crop at 13.5-14.4 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Industry sees French maize crop at 13.5-14.4 mln T.

text.p: Grain industry estimates put the 1997 French maize crop at between 13.5 and 14.4 million tonnes, the maize growers association AGPM said on Thursday.
In its monthly report for August, the AGPM, which avoided giving its own estimate for the 1997 harvest, said these forecasts assumed yields of 7.8 to 8.1 tonnes per hectare
"At this stage crop prospects are average to very good depending on region," AGPM only said.
But a source close to the AGPM put the yield potential at 8.4 tonnes, saying the crop received plenty of moisture in its early development stage.
AGPM said in the report that crop growth was initially ahead but rain in July and cooler temperatures had cancelled that advantage, bringing development into line with an average year.
The French farm ministry has forecast sowings may be up three percent to 1.776 million hectares but the AGPM said it expected sowings to be steady at around 1.725 million hectares.
In 1996 France produced 14.3 million tonnes of maize and yields reached 8.49 tonnes, ministry data show. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
